pages.text: 下午，咘咘在外面草地上玩，跑着跑着，一根小刺扎进了她的手心里，又细又尖。她一下子愣住了，手不敢动，也不敢握起来，眼泪在眼眶里打转，小声说：“好疼，好疼！”
pages.text_en: In the afternoon, Bubu played on the grass outside, and as she ran, a little thorn pricked her palm, thin and sharp. She froze at once, afraid to move her hand or close it, tears welling up in her eyes, whispering, "It hurts, it hurts!"

pages.text: 妈妈跑过来，轻轻握住咘咘的手，仔细看了看那根小刺，温柔地说：“别怕，妈妈在这里。刺要请出来，不然手会一直疼，一直不舒服。”咘咘缩了一下，小声说：“要用针吗？我害怕针！”
pages.text_en: Mummy ran over and gently held Bubu's hand, looking carefully at the little thorn, and said gently, "Don't be afraid. Mummy is here. The thorn has to come out, or your hand will keep hurting and feeling uncomfortable." Bubu shrank back and whispered, "With a needle? I am scared of needles!"

pages.text: 咘咘想起以前的事：猪猪去医院打针的时候，她陪猪猪数 1、2、3，数完针就打完了；自己摔倒膝盖疼的时候，爸爸妈妈陪她慢慢站起来，疼也慢慢过去了。她小声对自己说：“我害怕，但是我可以试试。”
pages.text_en: Bubu remembered before: when Zhuzhu went to the hospital for a shot, she counted 1, 2, 3 with Zhuzhu, and when the counting ended the shot was done; when she fell and hurt her knee, Mummy and Daddy helped her stand up slowly, and the hurt slowly passed. She whispered to herself, "I am scared, but I can try."

pages.text: 这时候，NOMI 跑过来蹲下，轻轻握住咘咘另一只手说：“害怕是正常的。害怕是身体在提醒你：小心一点，请大人帮忙，不要自己硬撑。”NONO 也飞过来，停在咘咘肩膀上陪着她，一动不动，像个小小的守护者。
pages.text_en: Just then, NOMI ran over and crouched down, gently holding Bubu's other hand. "Being scared is normal. Fear is your body reminding you: be careful, and ask a grown-up for help. Don't try to bear it alone." NONO flew over too and sat on Bubu's shoulder with her, perfectly still, like a tiny guardian.

pages.text: 妈妈说：“我们先呼吸一次，像闻花一样慢慢吸气，再像吹泡泡一样慢慢吐气。”咘咘跟着妈妈做：吸——吐——吸——吐——，做了好几次，心跳慢了一点，手也不抖得那么厉害了。
pages.text_en: Mummy said, "Let us breathe once first. Breathe in slowly like smelling a flower, and breathe out slowly like blowing a bubble." Bubu followed Mummy: in, out, in, out, several times. Her heartbeat slowed a little, and her hands did not shake so hard.

pages.text: Coco 在旁边小声数：“One, two, three！一、二、三！”妈妈用小针轻轻挑了一下，咘咘握紧妈妈的手，跟着一起数：“一、二、三！”数到三的时候，妈妈的手停住了，咘咘屏住呼吸看着自己的手。
pages.text_en: Coco counted softly beside them, "One, two, three!" Mummy picked gently with a little needle, and Bubu held Mummy's hand tight, counting along, "One, two, three!" When they reached three, Mummy's hand stopped, and Bubu held her breath and looked at her own hand.

pages.text: 小刺出来了！妈妈给咘咘的手贴了一个小小的贴纸，上面画着一颗小星星。咘咘看着自己的手，小声说：“还是有一点点疼，但没有刚才那么害怕了，好像害怕也跟着小刺一起出来了。”
pages.text_en: The little thorn came out! Mummy put a small sticker on Bubu's hand, with a little star drawn on it. Bubu looked at her hand and said softly, "It still hurts a little, but I am not as scared as before. It feels as if the fear came out together with the little thorn."

pages.text: 妈妈紧紧抱了抱咘咘，在她耳边说：“你害怕，还愿意让妈妈帮忙，这就是勇敢。”咘咘靠在妈妈怀里点点头，轻声说：“勇敢不是不害怕，是害怕的时候还可以试试，还可以请人帮忙。”
pages.text_en: Mummy hugged Bubu tightly and whispered in her ear, "You were scared, and you still let Mummy help. That is brave." Bubu nodded against Mummy's chest and said softly, "Brave does not mean not scared. It means trying even when you are scared, and asking someone for help."

pages.text: 后来，咘咘拉着妈妈的手说：“下次去医院打针，我也可以数 1、2、3，握着你的手，像今天这样。”妈妈笑着说：“好，妈妈陪你数，数到三就好了，妈妈会一直握着你的手。”
pages.text_en: Later, Bubu took Mummy's hand and said, "Next time I go to the hospital for a shot, I can also count 1, 2, 3 and hold your hand, just like today." Mummy smiled. "Good. Mummy will count with you. When we reach three it will be done, and Mummy will keep holding your hand all the way."

pages.text: 晚上，咘咘坐在沙发上，把今天的事讲给爸爸听：“我的手扎了刺，妈妈用针挑出来了。我害怕，但是我数数了，还呼吸了。”爸爸认真地听着，摸摸她的头说：“你做得真好，害怕的时候还能记得这些办法。”
pages.text_en: At night, sitting on the sofa, Bubu told Daddy what happened today. "My hand got a thorn, and Mummy picked it out with a needle. I was scared, but I counted, and I breathed too." Daddy listened seriously, patted her head and said, "You did so well. Even when you were scared, you still remembered these ways."

pages.text: 咘咘看着手上的小贴纸，又看了看窗外慢慢暗下来的天，轻轻说：“疼的时候，害怕会来；疼过去了，害怕也会慢慢走，就像天黑了还会再亮一样。”NOMI 在旁边点点头：“对，害怕会来，也会走。”
pages.text_en: Bubu looked at the little sticker on her hand, then at the sky outside slowly darkening, and said softly, "When it hurts, fear comes. When the hurt passes, fear slowly goes too, just as after darkness it brightens again." NOMI nodded beside her. "Yes, fear comes, and fear goes."

pages.text: 咘咘知道，下一次害怕的时候，她可以先呼吸，再请大人帮忙，数 1、2、3，慢慢试一试。就算害怕还在，也没关系，因为她已经知道害怕的时候该怎么办了。
pages.text_en: Bubu knew that next time she felt scared, she could breathe first, ask a grown-up for help, count 1, 2, 3, and try slowly. Even if the fear was still there, it was okay, because she already knew what to do when she felt scared.
